feeds.title: The Podiatric Dermatology Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Podiatric Dermatology Blog site which contains information on all aspects of foot dermatology for podiatrists and other healthcare professionals. I am Ivan Bristow. I am passionate about dermatology and education so putting these two things together into the website is my mission.

feeds.title: Betafeet Podiatry Blog
feeds.description: Betafeet Podiatry offers expert assessments and treatments from fully qualified podiatrists. With over three decades of experience, our podiatry clinics in Tring and Hemel Hempstead have helped countless clients with accurate diagnoses of foot issues and innovative treatments, all performed with a friendly and professional manner.

feeds.title: Sports Podiatry Info Blog
feeds.description: Ian completed his BSc (Hons) degree in Podiatry in 2003 and went on to obtain a postgraduate certificate in Sports Podiatry and a Masters degree in Sports Injury. He has maintained an active interest in research, having published work in The British Journal of Sports Medicine, The Journal of Foot & Ankle Research and The Journal of the American Podiatric Medical Association.
